stemMd:
A museum replaced a damaged label with a clearer one. Visitors subsequently spent less time reading the label but answered more questions about the object correctly. The change suggests that shorter reading time can sometimes reflect ______.

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.label: A
options.textMd: proof that labels never help visitors

options.label: B
options.textMd: the disappearance of all interest in the object

options.label: D
options.textMd: more efficient understanding rather than reduced engagement

explanationMd: Less time alone could have several meanings. Combined with improved answers, it is consistent with information becoming easier to understand rather than with visitors simply disengaging.

distractorRationale.a: This label change was followed by better performance.
distractorRationale.c: The improved answers contradict that interpretation.
distractorRationale.b: Better comprehension is compatible with continuing interest.
